title: Every step callable on its own
description: Engineering consequence of QR Code Generation, 1. The pipeline at a glance; QR Code Generation, Generating a QR Code.

statements.label: Every step callable on its own
statements.requirement: Each pipeline step SHALL be exposed as a separate public operation (payload codec, CWT build, CBOR, COSE sign/parse, ZLIB, Base45, HC1 prefix, QR) as well as through the end-to-end issuer and verifier, so that integrators can substitute or inspect any stage.

sources.quote: The first step below is therefore a selection step, and everything after it is mechanical.
